info.name: RewardProgram API — DEV
info.description:
RewardProgram API collection for Development (localhost).

**Setup:**
1. Import this collection
2. The base URL is set to `https://localhost:44315`
3. In Development mode, any 6-digit OTP code works (e.g. `123456`)

**Seeded Users (all pre-approved):**
- SystemAdmin: `0500000001`
- ZoneManagers: `0500000002` – `0500000006`
- SalesMan+ZoneManager (dual): `0500000007` – `0500000009`
- SalesMan: `0500000010` – `0500000031`

**OTP-first Registration Flow:**
1. Send OTP → get pinId
2. Register (shop-owner/seller/technician) with pinId + OTP → user created

**Login Flow:**
1. Login → get pinId
2. Verify Login → get JWT token + refresh token (auto-saved)
3. Use Approval/Scan/Wallet endpoints (JWT auto-attached)

item.description: Public lookup endpoints — no authentication required.

request.description: Returns all active regions. Use a region's `id` for the next request.

Returns all 140 active cities.

Check if ShopData already exists for a CustomerCode.

For Seller registration only — determines if shop fields are needed.
ShopOwner always provides all shop fields regardless.

item.name: Registration
item.description:
User registration endpoints — no authentication required.

OTP-first flow:
1. Send OTP → get pinId
2. Register with pinId + OTP → user created (no separate verify step)

request.description:
Send registration OTP to a new mobile number. Checks mobile uniqueness.

Auto-saves `pinId` from response.
Resend OTP to a mobile number. Auto-saves new `pinId`.

Verify OTP received via WhatsApp. Consumes the OTP and returns a signed verification token (10-min expiry) to use in registration.

Auto-saves `verificationToken` from response.

Flow: send-otp → verify-registration-otp → register

formdata.description: Must exist in ErpCustomer table. Only one ShopOwner per CustomerCode.
Same mobile used in Send OTP
Optional — 8-char invitation code from an existing user's invite link

request.description:
Register a new shop owner. Uses form-data for file upload support.

ShopOwner ALWAYS provides all shop data fields.
If ShopData was previously created by a Seller, the ShopOwner's data overwrites it.
Only one ShopOwner per CustomerCode allowed.

Requires verificationToken from Verify Registration OTP step.

formdata.description: Same mobile used in Send OTP
Required if first registration for this CustomerCode
Optional — 8-char invitation code from an existing user's invite link

request.description:
Register a new seller. Uses form-data for file upload support.

First Seller for a CustomerCode provides shop data. Subsequent Sellers skip.

Requires verificationToken from Verify Registration OTP step.

Register a new technician. Fill in `cityId` from Lookups.

Name: 3+ letters only (Arabic/English), no numbers.
PostalCode: 5 digits.

Requires verificationToken from Verify Registration OTP step.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Login and token management.

**Login Flow:**
1. Login → get pinId
2. Verify Login → get JWT token + refresh token (auto-saved)

**Seeded users for testing:**
- SalesMan: `0500000010`
- ZoneManager: `0500000002`
- Dual (SM+ZM): `0500000007`

request.description:

Auto-saves `pinId`.

Verify login with OTP. In dev mode any 6-digit code works.

Auto-saves `token` and `refreshToken` to collection variables.

Refresh an expired JWT token. Requires authentication.

Auto-saves new `token` and `refreshToken`.
Revoke refresh token (logout). Requires authentication.

item.name: Scanning
item.description:
Barcode scanning endpoints.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT — login with an approved Seller/Technician mobile first.

request.description:
Scan a barcode to earn points.

BarcodeCode must be exactly 12 characters (NanoID).
Latitude/Longitude are optional — sent by frontend if GPS is available.
Seller and Technician each scan once per barcode.
When both roles scan → barcode becomes Consumed.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

Get paginated scan history for the current user.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

Wallet and transaction endpoints.

request.description:
Get current point balance and SAR balance.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description:
Mobile app home screen endpoint.

Returns user name, points balance, SAR balance, redemption progress, and recent 10 transactions in a single call.

Requires ShopOwner, Seller, or Technician JWT.

request.description:
Get the mobile app home screen data.

**Response:**
- `userName`: Display name
- `points`: Current point balance
- `sarBalance`: Current SAR balance
- `minimumRedemptionPoints`: Admin-configured minimum (default 1000)
- `pointsToRedeem`: Points remaining to reach minimum (0 if already enough)
- `canRedeem`: Whether user has enough points to redeem
- `recentTransactions`: Last 10 wallet transactions (type: 1=Earned, 2=Redeemed, 3=Cancelled, 4=Expired, 5=Refunded, 6=InvitationReward)

Requires ShopOwner, Seller, or Technician JWT.

item.name: Invitation
item.description:
Invitation/referral system endpoints.

Each approved user gets a unique 8-char invitation code + QR code + shareable link.
New users can provide an invitation code at registration.
When the invited user gets approved, both inviter (100 pts) and invitee (50 pts) receive rewards.
Inviter reward is capped at 20 approved invitations.

Requires ShopOwner, Seller, or Technician JWT.

request.description:
Get your invitation code, shareable link, and invitation stats.

Lazy-generates the invitation code on first call if missing. The QR code is rendered client-side from `shareLink` (e.g. `qr_flutter`).

**Response:**
- `invitationCode`: 8-char alphanumeric code
- `shareLink`: Full URL for sharing (e.g. https://app.raedrewardapp.com/invite/ABC12345)
- `totalInvitations`: Total users who registered with your code
- `approvedInvitations`: How many of those were approved
- `totalPointsEarned`: Total points earned from invitation rewards

Requires ShopOwner, Seller, or Technician JWT.

item.name: Redemption
item.description:
Points redemption endpoints.

Seller and Technician can request to redeem points for SAR.
Methods: Cash handover or Bank Transfer.
3-level approval flow.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

request.description:
Get available balance for redemption.

**Response:**
- `totalBalance`: Total point balance
- `heldBalance`: Points held in pending requests
- `availableBalance`: Points available to redeem
- `availableSarBalance`: Available balance in SAR

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

Request points redemption.

**Method:** 1=Cash, 2=BankTransfer
**pointsAmount:** Must be >= minimumRedemptionPoints and <= available balance.

For BankTransfer: iban, bankName, accountHolderName required.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

Get the current active redemption request, if any. Returns 404 if none.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

Get paginated redemption request history.

Requires Seller or Technician JWT.

request.description:

Requires SalesMan, ZoneManager, or SystemAdmin JWT.
